articles.title: U.S. Senate opens first stage of crypto Clarity Act voting to give bill a chance next month
articles.snippet: The majority leader opened the multi-stage process the Senate follows when trying to get a bill over its 60-vote hurdle, so it's still got a shot in September.

articles.title: U.S. widens Iran crypto crackdown with sanctions on two exchanges
articles.snippet: The Treasury's OFAC targeted Shelbit and Aban Tether as Washington continues its effort to cut Tehran's access to crypto and foreign currency.

articles.title: Russia cracks down on unlicensed crypto exchanges it claims are linked to Ukraine
articles.snippet: The FSB said at least 20 individuals were arrested in connection with a ring that scammed an undetermined number of Russian citizens.

articles.title: BIP-110 Bitcoin branch stalls after two blocks as gap widens
articles.snippet: The enforcing fork remains stuck at Bitcoin’s full mining difficulty as mandatory signaling proceeds with little hashpower support.

articles.title: Domestic stablecoins could boost demand for dollar-backed tokens: IMF
articles.snippet: IMF first deputy managing director Dan Katz says users may favor digital dollars for their liquidity, network effects and cross-border acceptance.
